scope: Independent CURRENT source/handbook reconciliation. Source presence is not all-rules-complete or native correctness/strength proof.

status_meaning.SOURCE_PRESENT: Required branch found in source at cited symbol; no native verification claimed.
status_meaning.BOUNDED_PRIMARY: Primary decision exists with explicit finite conservative bounds; does not claim optimizer/optimality.
status_meaning.PERMITTED_BASELINE: Handbook expressly permits this fixed recipe/local/uncertain fallback as first implementation.
status_meaning.REQUIRED_PARTIAL: A substantive specified primary remains absent or materially approximated; fallback is not relabelled complete.
status_meaning.OPTIONAL_OMITTED: Explicit optional scope omitted; existing mechanics still handled.
status_meaning.VALIDATION_PENDING: Final-byte actual engine/representative evidence must come from root/harness.

topics.title: Win condition
topics.required_behavior: Make feasible completed tribute reaching 1000, then completed deadline score, outrank discretionary work.
topics.permitted_bounded_fallback_or_optional_s: Unknown opposing future events remain unknown; use actual public score and our legal route.
topics.edge_acceptance_scenario: A 4-gem winning bank must beat an attractive camp; a channel starting before limit but finishing after cannot count.
topics.source_observation: Deciding bank and deadline ordering; actual tribute count and ring approach, hard lethal next-reply veto.
topics.verification: Source inspection only. Native/fixture evidence is separately scoped; no Verified designation.

topics.title: Score awareness
topics.required_behavior: Refresh both public banked scores and our/visible credible bags after changes; protect our finish or feasible visible winning interruption.
topics.permitted_bounded_fallback_or_optional_s: Ordinary income/risk policy if evidence does not identify a deciding event.
topics.edge_acceptance_scenario: Enemy hidden bag is never fabricated; score change invalidates an old ordinary farm proposal.
topics.source_observation: Public banked scores and personally visible bags; visible deciding conversion interruption.
topics.verification: Source inspection only. Native/fixture evidence is separately scoped; no Verified designation.

topics.title: Gems versus gold
topics.required_behavior: Keep existing bag separate from new personal rewards; camp value includes legal travel, clear, collect, bank and incremental recovery.
topics.permitted_bounded_fallback_or_optional_s: Inherited gold weights 0.25 before600/0.24 afterward are explicit heuristic defaults, not optima.
topics.edge_acceptance_scenario: Compare bag24+reward24 with bank24: no numerator may count existing24 twice; private share cannot give every helper full reward.
topics.source_observation: Ordinary pure-gold detours remain ineligible. One explicitly priced cash-acquisition itinerary can name an observed singleton gold job, exact affordable future bundle and separate observed gem return; future money never changes current stats. Finite receipt, sharing and completed-cycle checks bound this special purpose.
topics.verification: Source inspection only. Native/fixture evidence is separately scoped; no Verified designation.

topics.title: Aggression level
topics.required_behavior: Choose a named fight/objective only when a bounded legal sequence survives credible reply and protects bag/exit.
topics.permitted_bounded_fallback_or_optional_s: Conservative useful local sequence when uncertain, rather than unsafe camp fallback.
topics.edge_acceptance_scenario: Declined losing fight cannot proceed to the camp hit whose cooldown/health made it losing.
topics.source_observation: Legal local sequences and credible reply/HP floors; no calibrated probabilities or global fight oracle.
topics.verification: Source inspection only. Native/fixture evidence is separately scoped; no Verified designation.

topics.title: Game phases
topics.required_behavior: Opening and late-game priorities follow observed feasibility and deciding completion; time weights may remain configured baselines.
topics.permitted_bounded_fallback_or_optional_s: Round600 weight and1850 fallback bank are retained explicitly; named-map bag overrides removed.
topics.edge_acceptance_scenario: On unseen geometry, deadline overrides ordinary lease/chain; fixed phase label cannot force an unsafe fight.
topics.source_observation: Actual finish feasibility overrides discretionary farming; late fallback remains configured rather than map-name specific.
topics.verification: Source inspection only. Native/fixture evidence is separately scoped; no Verified designation.

topics.title: Power spikes

topics.permitted_bounded_fallback_or_optional_s: No global spike schedule required; select the current legal local mission.
topics.edge_acceptance_scenario: Health purchase changes maxHP; stale pre-buy HP denominator cannot trigger a false engage/recall.
topics.source_observation: Current equipment/HP/action permissions refresh after purchases and accepted effects; no unverified future passive.
topics.verification: Source inspection only. Native/fixture evidence is separately scoped; no Verified designation.

topics.title: Opportunity cost
topics.required_behavior: Compare tasks through one completed-bank endpoint and next useful work, charging only incremental absence/recovery.
topics.permitted_bounded_fallback_or_optional_s: If next-bank estimate unsupported retain useful incumbent or threshold fallback; no fictitious probability.
topics.edge_acceptance_scenario: Necessary heal not charged twice; elective healthy recall cannot receive fictitious gems for healing.
topics.source_observation: Bank-now/job-first share a completed-bank endpoint and a cached named continuation when available. Actual-wallet bundle can name a finite observed gem job separately from its original mission; unsupported future income is not credited.
topics.verification: Source inspection only. Native/fixture evidence is separately scoped; no Verified designation.

topics.title: Playing ahead or behind

topics.permitted_bounded_fallback_or_optional_s: Conservative productive choice when comeback estimation lacks evidence.
topics.edge_acceptance_scenario: Behind on kills but ahead in banked score must not induce blind aggression; no hopeless chase when small safe bank decides.

topics.title: Grouping versus splitting
topics.required_behavior: Join only when timely added secured outcome beats helper alternative/absence; release excess clearers after job.
topics.permitted_bounded_fallback_or_optional_s: Keep incumbent if join value unresolved; productive split instead of largest-group following.
topics.edge_acceptance_scenario: Third helper after safe clear cannot receive full reward numerator or speed capture; 2v1 late arrival declined.
topics.source_observation: The marginal solo/pair/full comparison exists when a new local assignment is evaluated. However a continuously valid current solo/basic or DirectCastOnly job takes its funded continuation before that comparison, and a named Clear crew revalidates retained IDs without deliberately resizing their economic assignments. Independently arriving helpers may still contribute; this is not no-cooperation behavior. Dynamic resizing of useful existing jobs remains a substantive source-level gap, not a measured native harm/benefit claim.

topics.title: Group size

It credits no beneficial cast/heal/shield. Unsupported cases retain the detailed shared-selector forecast, whose hard17tick native cost is still a known limitation. A failed cheap proof never establishes necessity or infeasibility.

This remains a bounded local scheduler, not a global optimal partition.
